question: What did P. F. Strawson think would survive even a proof that determinism is true?
answer: Resentment, gratitude and indignation. In his 1962 lecture Freedom and Resentment, Strawson called these reactive attitudes part of having relationships with people at all, not conclusions drawn from a theory of causes. No proof could talk people out of them, any more than out of friendship. A betrayal is resented whatever physics says.
move: Before arguing someone out of a feeling, ask whether reasoning ever put it there.
reference: Strawson, Freedom and Resentment, Proceedings of the British Academy 48, 1962
